title: Functorial ring maps on principal adic completions
statement: For commutative rings $R,S$, a ring map $f:R\to S$ and $\pi\in R$, the induced map on principal adic completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] is $\widehat f:\widehat R_{(\pi)}\to\widehat S_{(f(\pi))}$, sending the $n$th residue of $x$ to its image under $R/(\pi)^n\to S/(f(\pi))^n$. More explicitly, $(\pi)^n\subseteq f^{-1}((f(\pi))^n)$ for every $n$, so this residue map is well defined; its composites with reductions to smaller powers agree with the smaller residue maps. The completed map is the ring map obtained by these compatible residues, with componentwise operations, and contains no choice of representatives.
